submitted.rationale: XRD on four compositions spread across the library showed the same main phase everywhere: a dominant peak at Q≈2.79 with minor peaks at 3.21, 4.55 and 5.34 Å⁻¹. The only exception was a small extra reflection at Q≈1.16 in the Ca-rich corner. So I used the three merit measurements on the Co-rich (21), Mn-rich (146) and Ca-rich (43) corners. None gave a positive photocurrent under 2.72 eV light: 21 = -6e-8 A, 146 = 0.0 A, 43 = -1.5e-7 A. Index 146 (Mn-rich) has the highest measured merit. It is the least negative value, not a real positive photoresponse.

rejected.reason: Co-rich corner gave a slightly negative photocurrent (-6e-8 A)
Ca-rich corner, which has an extra low-Q phase, gave the most negative photocurrent (-1.5e-7 A)

rejected.hypothesis: Pick a new point near the best of the first two
rejected.reason: Both first measurements were about zero, so there was no gradient to follow. The last measurement went to the one untested corner, which also has a different phase.
